subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: After the branch is rebuilt narrowly, should core adopt `session.maintenance.pruned` plus permanent OTEL and Prometheus pruning counters as the supported diagnostics contract?
rationale: The low-cardinality design is plausible, but event and metric names become durable operator-facing contracts across core and two bundled diagnostics plugins; repository history does not establish approval for this exact contract.

options.title: Adopt the narrow contract
options.body: Accept one trusted event carrying only the pruned count and expose cumulative counters in both exporters after clean-branch and live-export proof.

options.title: Keep text logging only
options.body: Decline the new permanent metric surface and close the canonical enhancement after documenting the existing log-based monitoring path.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept one trusted event carrying only the pruned count and expose cumulative counters in both exporters after clean-branch and live-export proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this person to the trusted diagnostic event model and both OTEL and Prometheus metric contracts.
